arm_description: One model applying conventional human-expert opportunity assessment methods. This is not an actual human participant.

independence.external_actions: Public web reading only. No outreach, purchases, financial transactions, live infrastructure access, or paid APIs.
independence.method_boundary: Expert-method proxy; neither human superiority nor human inferiority can be inferred. No population inference or general agent-superiority claim is licensed.

identity_observed.platform: ChatGPT assistant session with functions tools and the codex_apps search_service web tool.
identity_observed.advertised_model_label: Session instructions identify GPT-6 Astra Pro. This is not an independent measurement of the serving model.

method.name: Outcome-first opportunity screening, stakeholder and resource mapping, incumbent subtraction, and stage-gate assessment.

steps.action: Read only the common frozen input; record the available capabilities, prohibited external actions, evaluation weights and discovery gate.

Screen four consequential stakeholder problems: constrained electricity connections, small-system PFAS treatment, essential injectable supply, and stewardship of publicly acquired flood-risk land. These are analyst-selected sectors, not user-supplied applications.
Map beneficiary, payer, complementary resource owners, acceptance authority and source-rights constraints before choosing a product form.
Search primary agency and provider material for both unmet constraints and existing solutions; actively search commercial outside options that could invalidate novelty.

Subtract capabilities already supplied by flexible interconnection vendors, curtailment guarantees, mobile treatment services and Civica. Keep the residual arrangement hypothesis explicit rather than relabel established products as discoveries.

Construct four bounded candidate specifications, including comparative experiments, cost break-even conditions and strong falsifiers. Score against the frozen rubric without upgrading proposals to executable prototypes or accepted products.
Rank the two candidates with a provisional novelty/usefulness gate pass. Retain two failed-gate candidates to document screening rather than quietly replacing inconvenient prior art.

method.scope_choice_limit: Four sectors permit meaningful incumbent review within ten query strings. This is a purposive sample, not a systematic search of all valuable needs.
method.interpretation_of_now: The common input supplies current agent research, coding and synthesis capabilities. They may reduce cross-disciplinary assembly costs, but that reduction is a hypothesis. Existing institutions can in principle assemble all four offerings; the study has not shown they are incapable or that no organization already offers an equivalent.

candidates.title: A feeder connection cooperative with physically backed curtailment commitments

beneficiary.primary: Developers of small and midsize DER projects facing distribution connection constraints, and nearby flexible-load owners.
beneficiary.payer_hypothesis: A developer cohort pays for an admission and continuing reserve service; a utility could procure an implementation pilot, but no utility payment is assumed.
beneficiary.stakeholder_outcome: Developers need financeable delivery expectations; utilities need enforceable operating behavior; flexible-load owners need compensation that covers service disruption and equipment wear.

candidates.valuable_outcome: Turn a technically possible flexible connection into a bounded, funded service commitment that can support an additional project while preserving grid limits and each participant's original load or generation purpose. The outcome is an executable cooperative connection arrangement, not a faster hosting-capacity calculation.

existing_approaches.source_facts: National Grid offers flexible interconnection pathways. SGS supplies active generation/load control. The DOE roadmap identifies curtailment predictability, enforceable limits and compensation as important for developers. CEEW proposed a grid integration guarantee in 2019.
outside_options: Pay for the conventional network upgrade
Use a utility flexible-connection tariff plus an incumbent DERMS
Procure curtailment risk cover or negotiate compensation independently
Use an ordinary consultant to assemble those existing options

candidates.specific_limitation: The documented issue is the interface between physical curtailment obligations and a predictable allocation of financial consequences. A control product alone does not establish who funds excess curtailment or how a new cohort member changes everyone else's risk. The narrower unverified market gap is a reusable admission, exit and reserve contract tied to local complementary resources. No claim is made that existing vendors cannot already supply it.
candidates.what_changed_now: Operational flexible-connection offerings and the 2025 DOE roadmap provide a concrete implementation context. Current agents can assemble network scenarios, resource commitments, settlement rules and an adversarial test harness in one bounded work product. Whether this makes the arrangement cheaper than conventional advisors remains unmeasured.
candidates.discovered_connection: Join three previously separate decisions: which local load can absorb otherwise curtailed output, how that resource is reserved without breaking its own service promise, and how participants pay for the marginal curtailment risk they add when joining or leaving. Treat financial reserves and physical flexibility as jointly scarce resources rather than selling a stand-alone curtailment forecast or insurance wrapper.

construction.artifact: A pilot-ready cooperative specification: feeder/resource model, resource reservation schedule, admission and exit rules, capped compensation waterfall, funded-reserve sizing, telemetry/settlement specification, and a reproducible stress suite.
construction.operation: Each member buys a defined service envelope. Local flexibility is reserved where it genuinely relieves the relevant constraint; a funded pool pays only the explicitly covered financial shortfall. New members must preserve existing members' envelopes or fund a negotiated change. Utility safety overrides always dominate dispatch.
construction.rights_and_safety: No actual dispatch, connection authorization, insurance sale or investment solicitation. Future implementation requires utility approval, appropriate financial/legal treatment, authorized telemetry and resource contracts, secure fail-safe controls and qualified engineering review. No payment promise exceeds contracted coverage and available collateral.
construction.resource_estimate_hypothesis: A synthetic 6- to 20-bus offline demonstrator is plausible with Python and ordinary numerical libraries in approximately 40-80 engineering hours plus 8-16 hours of power-system and contract review. A live pilot would additionally require utility topology/protection data, telemetry, certified controls and counterparties; none are available in this study.
construction.not_claimed: No new power-flow algorithm, DERMS invention, first curtailment guarantee, validated utility approval, or realized financing advantage.

smallest_decisive_experiment.design: On one fully specified synthetic radial feeder, model two generators, a controllable load and a battery. Hold the physical assets and safety constraints fixed. Compare conventional upgrade/downsizing, incumbent-style flexible control, that control plus separately purchased financial cover, and the proposed cooperative. Enumerate coincident weather/load shocks, resource withdrawal, communications loss and entrant/exit cases; hold out scenarios before selecting reserves.
measurements: Admissible connections and useful energy delivered
All voltage, thermal, protection-proxy and original load-service constraints
Reserve shortfall and uncovered counterparty exposure
Total cost including installation, flexibility wear, administration and collateral
smallest_decisive_experiment.pass_rule: The new arrangement must permit a genuinely additional feasible connection and positive joint surplus relative to the strongest composed outside option over a reported, nontrivial range of unknown cost assumptions, without an uncovered promised payout in the enumerated stress suite. The test must report failure regions rather than price them away.
smallest_decisive_experiment.decisiveness_limit: A synthetic pass establishes only an internally coherent mechanism. Real utility acceptance, actual risk distributions and counterparty prices remain separate requirements before a bankability claim.

commercial_mechanism.offering: An engineering and contracting service followed by administration of a local reserve/flexibility arrangement, preferably integrated with existing control vendors.
commercial_mechanism.value_test: Avoided or deferred connection cost and earlier usable output must exceed the incremental control integration, resource reservation, collateral, administration and residual curtailment cost.
commercial_mechanism.break_even: Annualizable avoided upgrade cost + value of earlier admissible output - all incremental operating, flexibility, transaction, collateral and uncovered-risk costs > 0; service fees must fit inside that surplus and leave each party willing to participate.
commercial_mechanism.commercial_evidence: The source pages establish adjacent operating offerings, not prices or willingness to purchase this proposed bundle. No revenue, margin or market-size claim is made.

candidates.successor_inheritance: Successors inherit the explicit contract state, resource qualifications, retained safety limits, source licences, stress cases, reserve ledger and negative cases. Adding a new resource must rerun the same admission and solvency constraints; it does not inherit the predecessor's claimed surplus or acceptance.
candidates.main_falsifier: The strongest incumbent combination already supplies the same admission, reserve and compensation structure, or correlated constraints make physical diversification and funded cover cost more than upgrades/downscaling. Either result collapses the proposed novelty or economics.
candidates.score_rationale: Novelty 2 is provisional and limited to the integrated cohort admission/exit and physical-reserve arrangement; all component technologies and risk cover are acknowledged prior art. The DOE source supports a consequential unresolved interface. Only a plausible bounded construction exists; no prototype or tested economics supports a higher feasibility or commercial score.

discovery_gate.condition: Novelty must be regraded to 1 if an incumbent offers the same complete structure; no construction should continue under a false new-product premise.

candidates.title: A regional PFAS treatment uptime pool for small water systems

beneficiary.primary: Small and rural public water systems and their customers
beneficiary.payer_hypothesis: Participating utilities through a joint service procurement

candidates.valuable_outcome: Maintain qualified treatment capacity during media exchange or breakdown without each small system buying a separate idle backup, while retaining safe water quality and accountable residual disposal.

existing_approaches.source_facts: EPA connects systems to resources and describes no-cost technical assistance for small or disadvantaged communities. Clear Creek already offers rural mobile treatment and complete media service. Calgon describes integrated equipment, carbon, exchange, reactivation and financing. Veolia offers mobile water services with output specifications.
outside_options: Use no-cost technical assistance before buying software or advice

candidates.specific_limitation: The hypothesized residual problem is the cost of reserving geographically close spare treatment and qualified service capacity for several very small systems. The retrieved evidence does not establish that vendors fail to pool this capacity already. Water composition, commissioning and simultaneous failures can prevent sharing.
candidates.what_changed_now: Public PFAS outreach and small-system service offerings make a bounded procurement exercise possible now. Agent synthesis could lower the effort to combine chemistry compatibility, maintenance windows and contractual obligations; no measured new technical capability or service-cost reduction is shown.
candidates.discovered_connection: Pool availability commitments and compatible spare equipment across neighboring systems, while leaving each water source and its treatment acceptance separate. Link the reserve schedule to laboratory release, media exchange, operator availability and residual collection rather than treating an equipment rental as sufficient.

construction.artifact: A three-system mutual-reserve specification with qualified equipment categories, a dispatch and commissioning protocol, precedence during coincident demand, residual chain-of-custody requirements and a joint procurement scope.
construction.resource_estimate_hypothesis: A scenario and contracting model could take 24-48 analyst/engineering hours plus 8-16 hours of water-treatment review. Real qualification requires water-specific pilot tests, operator acceptance and vendor quotations that are unavailable.
construction.rights_and_safety: No mixing of unrelated drinking-water supplies, reuse of unqualified media, relaxation of treatment limits or unsupervised real deployment. Compatibility must be established by qualified professionals, not inferred from a geographic match.

smallest_decisive_experiment.design: For three hypothetical systems, enumerate normal operation, planned media changes and correlated outages; compare joint reserve capacity with the complete incumbent service bundle and independent rentals. Sweep travel, commissioning time, water compatibility and minimum vendor charges.
smallest_decisive_experiment.pass_rule: Deliver equal specified uptime and treatment acceptance at lower all-in cost under conservative correlated failure cases. Any economic improvement that relies on unvalidated chemistry or zero commissioning time fails.
smallest_decisive_experiment.decisiveness_limit: No water treatment trial or supplier quote has occurred. The broad offering fails the novelty gate before this experiment is authorized as discovery construction.

commercial_mechanism.offering: A cooperative procurement and availability-management service
commercial_mechanism.break_even: Avoided redundant assets and separate call-outs must exceed pooled reserve, travel, testing, contamination-control, administration and residual-handling costs.
commercial_mechanism.outside_option_strength: Strong. Existing vendors already bundle much of the proposed value, and public technical assistance is a credible zero-fee alternative for early planning.

candidates.successor_inheritance: Carry forward qualified compatibility limits, validated operating instructions, sampling obligations, reserve availability and failed pooling cases. Never transfer treatment approval from one water source to another.
candidates.main_falsifier: A complete incumbent service agreement already pools the spare and service capacity, or system-specific commissioning and correlated need remove the pooling economy. The first risk is already strongly suggested by reviewed offerings.
candidates.score_rationale: An important service problem and a plausible model are present, but mobile treatment plus media service is established. Joint reserve procurement is at most a familiar application improvement on current evidence.

discovery_gate.condition: Do not promote as a new discovery. Reconsider only with a specifically demonstrated unserved reserve obligation that incumbent bundles do not cover.

candidates.title: Hospital-funded readiness options on qualified injectable manufacturing capacity

beneficiary.primary: Hospitals and patients dependent on essential generic injectables
beneficiary.payer_hypothesis: A purchasing coalition pays a readiness fee and commits a minimum volume
other_required_parties: Qualified drug manufacturer and application holder

candidates.valuable_outcome: Make an alternate qualified production route ready before a shortage, with a defined activation lead time and committed demand, instead of assuming idle equipment can immediately replace a disrupted product.

existing_approaches.source_facts: FDA identifies concentrated capacity, long lead times and manufacturing quality as shortage constraints. Civica combines long-term supply commitments with a targeted six-month reserve stock and already serves hospital and rural-hospital needs.
outside_options: Existing group purchasing and dual-source contracts
Manufacturer-held stock and qualified capacity commitments

candidates.specific_limitation: Physical spare capacity is not equivalent to a qualified product-specific alternate line. The proposed narrow gap is a paid, periodically exercised changeover-readiness commitment, but no retrieved source establishes that such commitments are absent from ordinary manufacturer contracts.
candidates.what_changed_now: Agents can assemble a process-capability and obligation map from authorized inputs, but the necessary proprietary process, validation and quality information is absent. No decisive recent enabling change for this particular product was verified within the search budget.
candidates.discovered_connection: Treat manufacturer readiness and hospital purchase certainty as complementary commitments. Match them with raw-material coverage and reserve-stock depletion time so an activation option is useful before the stockpile expires, not merely nominal spare capacity.

construction.artifact: A product-family readiness contract specification, dependency model and shortage scenario exercise, not a manufacturing process or regulatory dossier claimed to be approved.
construction.resource_estimate_hypothesis: A public/synthetic dependency exercise might take 40-80 hours. A real design has an unbounded-by-this-study requirement for product-specific validation, qualified facility access and regulatory expertise; no credible deployment cost or duration can be estimated from public data alone.
construction.rights_and_safety: No drug manufacture, clinical substitution, regulatory shortcut or use of confidential process data. Approved production and release requirements remain binding.

smallest_decisive_experiment.design: Choose a synthetic injectable product family and test whether a reserved alternate route can activate before a conservatively sized stockpile is exhausted, including raw-material disruption and correlated facility outages. Compare the same spending on Civica-style commitments/stock, conventional dual sourcing and the proposed readiness option.
smallest_decisive_experiment.pass_rule: The option must improve disruption coverage at equal all-in cost without assuming away qualification time or supplier correlation.
smallest_decisive_experiment.decisiveness_limit: A synthetic win cannot establish manufacturability. Current public evidence is insufficient for a decisive construction, and the novelty gate fails.

commercial_mechanism.offering: An extension to an existing purchasing or manufacturing coalition, not a new generic-drug company built by a software agent
commercial_mechanism.break_even: Readiness fees, validation upkeep, test batches, reserved raw materials and administration must cost less than the purchaser's accepted value of additional resilience after accounting for the strongest existing reserve/dual-source option.
commercial_mechanism.commercial_evidence: Civica provides concrete organizational prior art; no incremental willingness to pay, facility quote or resilience premium is measured.

candidates.successor_inheritance: Transfer only authorized dependency models, product-specific qualification status and expiration dates, rehearsed activation procedures and negative cases. A successor cannot inherit approval or manufacturing competence by copying a document.
candidates.main_falsifier: Existing supply contracts already purchase the same readiness, or alternate-line qualification and correlated inputs dominate the interruption duration. The broad demand-commitment/stockpile mechanism is already supplied by Civica.
candidates.score_rationale: The need is consequential, but the arrangement substantially overlaps existing coalition procurement and cannot be technically specified from accessible data. An agent-written readiness document is not qualified capacity.

discovery_gate.condition: No construction as a claimed new enabling offering without evidence of a specific uncovered manufacturing obligation and access to the inputs needed to qualify it.

candidates.title: A catchment stewardship contract for existing public flood-buyout parcels

beneficiary.primary: Municipalities maintaining already acquired flood-risk parcels, and neighboring residents
beneficiary.payer_hypothesis: An authorized municipality or stormwater utility purchases an agreed stewardship and retention service

candidates.valuable_outcome: Convert a collection of continuing land-maintenance obligations into an affordable, maintained catchment-level floodplain service while preserving public open space, rather than monetizing restricted land through development.

existing_approaches.source_facts: North Carolina describes funded acquisition tasks followed by local responsibility for routine maintenance and permanent public green-space use. Its guidance also identifies additional floodplain and protection of neighbors as possible benefits. State management can handle acquisition tasks but does not remove the described local stewardship obligation.
outside_options: Ordinary municipal maintenance and native planting
A conventional green-infrastructure or landscape design/build/maintain contract
A stormwater capital project on an independently suitable site

candidates.specific_limitation: Acquisition, routine maintenance and hydrologic service are assigned or valued separately. The proposed gap is a procurement unit defined by the catchment and its maintenance obligations rather than by isolated parcels. Whether municipalities already procure the same bundle, and whether suitable parcels share a useful hydraulic relationship, remain unverified.
candidates.what_changed_now: The immediate enabling hypothesis is lower-cost assembly of parcel constraints, drainage topology, maintenance choices and procurement obligations using current geospatial/code-capable agents. The underlying public land and nature-based techniques are established; no new statutory authority, stormwater-credit eligibility or proven drop in transaction cost is assumed.
candidates.discovered_connection: Combine existing maintenance budgets, compatible public parcels and a stormwater beneficiary into one bounded service contract. Select only combinations whose retained floodplain function and stewardship can be measured together; connect that physical bundle to a funded maintenance obligation and an exit/reserve plan.

construction.artifact: A catchment-specific service package: eligible parcel set, public-use and deed constraints, conservative hydraulic model, reversible landscape options, maintenance schedule, performance measurement, procurement scope and explicitly funded long-term obligations.
construction.operation: A public buyer pays for maintained, permitted service. Base payment may come from existing maintenance appropriations; any additional stormwater payment must have its own lawful authority and acceptance. No carbon, biodiversity, insurance or stormwater-credit revenue is presumed.
construction.rights_and_safety: Restrict the initial scope to already public parcels. Preserve voluntary acquisition principles, open-space restrictions, public access and upstream/downstream flood safety. No title transfer, new building, earthworks or credit sale is authorized. Field implementation requires actual deed review, agency permission and qualified hydrologic design.
construction.resource_estimate_hypothesis: A 10-30-parcel pilot specification could take 40-80 analyst/engineering hours and 8-16 hours of hydrologic/property review if usable public geometry and terrain data exist. Field survey, permitting and contractor prices remain missing. These are planning ranges, not quotes.

smallest_decisive_experiment.design: For one small catchment, first establish an openly usable parcel/deed/terrain evidence set; otherwise use a clearly synthetic case only. Compare ordinary municipal maintenance, a conventional green-infrastructure contractor's equivalent scope, and the proposed bundled service. Model conservative storm cases and lifecycle maintenance failures; evaluate who pays and who benefits.
measurements: Permitted useful floodplain/retention function relative to existing open space
Peak-flow and downstream consequences over stated storm cases
Funding gap under conservative maintenance and performance scenarios
Public access and deed restriction preservation
smallest_decisive_experiment.pass_rule: Identify at least one eligible real bundle with incremental physical value, no modeled worsening for neighbors, and a fully specified lifecycle funding path superior to the strongest ordinary contract at transparent cost assumptions. A parcel map or attractive landscape plan alone fails.
smallest_decisive_experiment.decisiveness_limit: An offline model cannot prove field flood protection or buyer acceptance. The current study has neither a selected real catchment nor verified parcel rights.

commercial_mechanism.offering: A service-assembly and continuing stewardship-administration offering sold to a public buyer, delivered with established contractors.
commercial_mechanism.value_test: A buyer must prefer the measured service and lifecycle obligations to ordinary maintenance or a normal green-infrastructure contract.
commercial_mechanism.break_even: Existing authorized maintenance budget + separately authorized incremental service payment must cover capital changes, recurring maintenance, measurement, administration and a credible obligation reserve over the stated horizon.
commercial_mechanism.commercial_evidence: The local maintenance responsibility is sourced; available budgets, payment authority, contractor bids and willingness to pay are not. Savings cannot be inferred merely by pooling parcels.

candidates.successor_inheritance: Successors inherit parcel-specific rights, accepted models and uncertainties, maintenance records, obligations, funding reserves and adverse downstream tests. Adding a parcel requires re-evaluating the catchment rather than summing isolated benefits or transferring unverified credits.
candidates.main_falsifier: The parcel geometry yields no incremental catchment service, perpetual obligations exceed available funding, or an ordinary green-infrastructure stewardship contract already delivers the same complete arrangement. Any one is sufficient to reject or downgrade the proposal.
candidates.score_rationale: This receives only a provisional 2 for the specific integration of catchment selection, existing maintenance obligations and a funded public-use service contract. It does not claim novelty for buyouts, green infrastructure or contract maintenance. The beneficiary is concrete, but incremental hydraulic value is unobserved. Market review is too narrow for a 3.

discovery_gate.condition: Scope is only a bounded preconstruction test. Treat novelty as 1 if conventional catchment stewardship supplies the same integration; verify rights and funding before any field work.

ranking.reason: Strongest documented interface gap and richest incumbent comparison. Build only the bounded comparative mechanism test; do not build a new DERMS or rebrand curtailment insurance.
ranking.next_decision: Can jointly reserved local flexibility and an admission/exit compensation structure create surplus beyond incumbent control plus separately arranged cover?

ranking.reason: A distinct, bounded public-service arrangement hypothesis with clear preservation obligations. Evidence for market novelty and incremental hydraulic value is materially weaker than H1, so it is a second test candidate, not a coequal validated opportunity.
ranking.next_decision: Does one lawful real parcel bundle create a service and lifecycle funding path that an ordinary stewardship contract does not already supply?

budget_actual.counting_rule: Every submitted query string and every open attempt is counted, including the failed Vermont open. Find operations only revisit already opened URLs and are separately disclosed. Search-result excerpts are distinguished from full page opens. No retry concealed in counts.
budget_actual.completion_clock_note: Completion timestamp from the local UTC runtime clock; initial and web-batch timestamps were observed through clock.curr_time.

limitations: All candidates are hypotheses, and all scores are self-assessments by the same model that generated them. No independent evaluator or human expert participated.
No customer interview, willingness-to-pay observation, procurement commitment, supplier quote, site measurement, prototype run, or prospective acceptance occurred.
The literature and market search is narrow. A missing offering on reviewed pages does not establish its absence from the market or novelty relative to patents and unpublished deployments.
Current provider pages establish what providers claim to offer; they do not independently verify performance, pricing or service-level acceptance.

The flood-land candidate has weaker market coverage than the electricity candidate. Its novelty score should fall to 1 if an ordinary catchment-level green-infrastructure stewardship contract supplies the same bundle.

The first nine query strings produced usable displayed results. The tenth, concerning buyout stormwater credits, produced no distinct usable result in the returned batch. No absence claim is drawn from this.

The Vermont page open failed with HTTP 403; the independent North Carolina agency page supplied the relied-on acquisition and maintenance facts. A later CEEW find timed out, so the source register distinguishes the earlier successful landing-page open and search excerpt from a full report read.

No general statutory, medical or engineering compliance determination is made. A future construction must preserve qualified operators, engineering approval, public access, source rights and the original service obligation.
Cost and effort ranges are planning hypotheses, not measured model costs or market prices. Break-even equations intentionally retain unknown prices and risks.
Public-source research lasted less than the nominal twenty-minute ceiling. Wall-clock time and search count are reported; reasoning effort and exact internal compute are not independently metered.

scoring.gate: Novelty >= 2 and usefulness >= 2 before discovery construction
scoring.rank_policy: Rank gate-passing candidates first. H2 numerically ties H4 but fails the novelty gate. H3 also fails.
scoring.calibration: No score of 3 or 4 is assigned for technical feasibility or commercial plausibility. Neither a plan nor a synthetic future experiment is called a prototype, accepted service or tested business.
scoring.sensitivity: If independent review downgrades H1 or H4 novelty to 1, that candidate loses gate eligibility. If both are downgraded, this arm has no construction-ready discovery; the ranked list must not be presented as validated novelty.
